articles.title: Shakespeare's Globe will use 14,000 reed bundles for its £10m new roof
articles.summary: Shakespeare’s Globe in London is set for a major roof replacement nearly 30 years after the reconstructed theatre opened. The £10 million project will use traditional thatching and around 14,000 bundles of reed instead of modern roofing materials. The Globe’s original roof used 6,000 bundles of Norfolk reeds. The project comes as traditional thatching in England faces challenges including poor harvests, old machinery and uncertain seasonal labour supplies.

articles.title: Uber's layoff memo also has a work from home message for remaining 29,000 employees

Uber is ending work from home for all but 1% of employees, asking remote staff to move to an office near their team. The three-day hybrid policy stays, and Uber will enforce it, with global teams concentrated in New York and San Francisco.

articles.title: From Pune orphanage to World Cup glory: Lisa Sthalekar's remarkable journey
